summary: Frontend-only E2E (Playwright, 1920x1080) for the iter27 backup/restore feature and weekly-summary Evolución text, on both bots. Everything requested works: the Backup section shows in Ajustes of Bybit and HotForex. 'Crear copia ahora' shows the toast, updates the last copy and adds a row to the list. 'Descargar última' downloads a real gzip file with the right name. While Bybit is running, the amber note and the dialog warning appear and Restaurar stays disabled even after typing RESTAURAR; Cancelar closes the dialog. With both bots stopped, restoring a local file (chunked upload + progress bar) and restoring a stored copy both succeeded ('Copia restaurada · 1611 documentos …'). After each restore the page reloaded and stayed logged in on /bybit. The weekly description mentions evolución in both bots and Vista previa loads without error. Regression: the Bybit panel and the Evolución tab load after the restore. Final state: Bybit restarted (BOT EN EJECUCIÓN), HotForex stopped.

design_issues.screen: Ajustes > Copias de seguridad (Bybit, right column bottom)
issues: The sonner toast (bottom-right) briefly covers the Descargar/Restaurar buttons of the backup-list rows right after creating a copy. Cosmetic, goes away when the toast closes.

action_items: Optional: the weekly preview had no 'Evolución' block in this test because there were 0 config changes this week (_evolution_lines returns [] when empty, which looks intentional). Consider a one-line 'Evolución: sin cambios esta semana' so users know the section exists.
Optional: backup 'last' metadata in the DB can point to a file that no longer exists on disk (seen before testing: last=043134 not in the list). The UI handles this fine because it shows backups[0].
critical_code_review_comments: RestoreBackupDialog accepts the confirm word without regard to case ('restaurar' enables the button and the backend accepts it). Fine, just noting it is intentional.
BackupSection.restore: if a chunk upload fails partway, the server keeps the partial upload under that upload_id. Make sure the backend cleans up abandoned uploads (TTL or cleanup step).
seed_data_creation: Made 3 backups during testing (043408, 043436, 043539) and deleted them afterwards; only the original test_database-2026-10-22_042802.json.gz is left in /app/backend/backups/. Both restores used the copy made right after stopping Bybit (043436), so the data was the same.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backup testids: backup-section, backup-last(-name), backup-create-button, backup-download-last, backup-pick-file, backup-file-input (hidden, set_input_files works), backup-file-selected, backup-file-restore, backup-list, backup-row-/backup-restore-/backup-download-<filename>, backup-restore-dialog/-confirm-input/-confirm/-cancel/-progress/-running-warning, backup-running-note. Bot toggle: bot-toggle-button (text INICIAR BOT/DETENER BOT). Bybit Evolución tab: tab-evolution; FX: fx-tab-evolution. Bybit must be left RUNNING and HotForex STOPPED.
